grounding.excerpt: *4 Once per permit term. The test is to be performed during the first springtime after the permit effective date, during the irrigation season
shall become effective on January 1, 2022. This permit and the authorization to discharge shall expire at midnight, December 31, 2026.

payload.rationale: The packet establishes the once-per-term WET requirement (first springtime after the January 1, 2022 effective date, during irrigation season), the permit term (2022–2026), and the FY2025 window. It does not establish whether the once-per-term WET test was performed or remains outstanding (known_missing_information). Per the relation contract, ACCEPT requires establishing FY2025 as a required WET year and REJECT requires establishing it is not required; neither burden is met without performance status. The temporal rule alone does not close whether an outstanding obligation could implicate FY2025. Preferring unsupported uncertainty to unsupported semantic closure, UNRESOLVED is correct.
